subject: tu:game/world/gauntworld
value: TWO MEASUREMENTS ON game/world/gauntworld, both re-runs of numbers a lane brief quoted, recorded because one moved and one did not. (1) RE-CENSUS under the widened alias mapper and reloc-VALUE comparison: ResolveWorldData 12 genuine (UNCHANGED from the brief), fn_8005C1DC 25 genuine (the brief said 27 - it MOVED, and its `real` also reads 424, not the 426 its own attempt record quotes), fn_80062A00 20 genuine, fn_8005F0F4 25 genuine (its record says 32 - MOVED), fn_8005BA1C 9 genuine, fn_800606FC 71 genuine. fn_800606FC is by a wide margin the TU's largest remaining genuine-row population and is NOT in any current lane's scope - it is the obvious next assignment. Every other roster function is EXACT or artifact-only. (2) THE UNSIZED-EXTERN / SDA21 SWEEP IS EXHAUSTED IN THIS TU, contrary to the standing suggestion to look for more instances. The mechanism is real and is recorded at attempt.GW_fn8005ba1c-sdata-sizes-subrecord-alias-and-switch.20260901.v1 (MWCC small-data-addresses an extern only when its DECLARED size is within the 8-byte sdata threshold, so an unsized `[]` array never gets EMB_SDA21), but its population in gauntworld was exactly the three labels that record already fixed. A full per-symbol join of the target's 506 `@sda21` operands (181 distinct symbols) against our object's 1453 relocation records returns ZERO symbols where the target uses EMB_SDA21 and we use ADDR16_HA/LO, and ZERO in the reverse direction. The only residue is naming, not addressing: our `sObjectsFile` is the target's `sObjectsFile_80112AB8` (same .rodata datum at 0x80112AB8, size 0xC, HA/LO on both sides) plus fourteen anonymous @NNNN pool labels - all reloc-naming artifacts, none a defect. METHOD NOTE worth more than the result: this sweep is cheap (two objdump/grep passes, no build) and it is the right FIRST action on any TU inheriting an 'apply this lever more widely' instruction, because it converts an open-ended hunt into a closed table before a single probe is spent.
